latin: Ex praecedenti conclusione intelligi potest cur euangelista Matheus, in quatuordecim illis generationibus ante Christum, quasdam dimiserit.
translation: From the preceding conclusion it can be understood why the evangelist Matthew, among those fourteen generations before Christ, omitted certain ones.
